boundaries.reason: Agent configuration, approval policies, hooks and the project dispatcher changed or added since 0.30.0 survive a release rollback.
boundaries.recovery: Stop agent sessions before rollback. After rollback, back up the listed files, remove only Subyard-managed approval hook and policy files, restore the target release's agent configuration and project dispatcher, and run yard init in each affected yard before restarting agents. Preserve operator-owned content.
